subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: English is essential for many jobs because communication across countries has become much easier. People from different nations need a (a) ------- language to understand each other, and English serves that role well. Whether talking to a Chinese maker or a French artist, one can use (b) ------- to communicate. In a country like Bangladesh, where job opportunities are limited, knowing English increases the (c) ------- of finding good employment both at home and abroad. However, many students only learn English to pass (d) ------- and not to use it in real life. To be successful, we must learn to use English in speaking and writing at various levels of (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) common; (b) English; (c) chance; (d) exams; (e) communication;
